verdict.rationale: Brex documents a broad API that covers most core UI domains: accounting, budgets, team/users/cards, expenses with receipt uploads, payments (ACH/wires/checks), transactions/statements, onboarding and webhooks, plus an official MCP server. However, nothing claims UI parity, and there are visible gaps: the Travel API is view-only, while the UI supports in-app bookings and itinerary changes. Missing for 10: an explicit documented API/UI parity commitment, write coverage for travel bookings and itinerary changes, documented API access to AI invoice entry and approval flows, and independent hands-on confirmation of coverage depth.
